description: Transfer 50,000 USDC and 5 ETH from the Main Treasury (Cold Safe) to the Operations Multisig (Hot Safe) to cover Q4 contributor payroll and gas reimbursements.

USDC.note: FiatTokenProxy; transfer emits Transfer(from, to, value)

MultiSendCallOnly v1.4.1.note: Safe batches by delegatecall to this contract; it only CALLs inner targets

execution.note: A batch of two actions is normally one execTransaction whose operation is DELEGATECALL to MultiSendCallOnly.multiSend; a single action is a plain CALL.
